lines: He's read his slides twenty times. Silently. In his head. Flawless.
Next morning, he opens his mouth... and nothing comes out.
His brain knew the words. His mouth had never met them.
Reading in your head and saying it out loud are different skills.
You only get better at the one you actually practise.
So rehearse out loud. Standing up. Three times. Once to a friend.
The first run will sound terrible. That's the run that counts.
Send this to the friend reading their slides on the train.
